defmodule MonitorAgent.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for monitoring agent"

  use GenServer

  defstruct [:token, :service_id, :callbacks, :state, :nonce_registry]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    state = %__MODULE__{
      token: nil,
      service_id: Keyword.get(opts, :service_id, "monitor-agent-1"),
      callbacks: %{},
      state: :unauthenticated,
      nonce_registry: MapSet.new()
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def authenticate(challenge) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:authenticate, challenge})
  end

  def register_log_callback(event_type, callback) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:register_callback, event_type, callback})
  end

  def process_event(event) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:process_event, event})
  end

  def handle_call({:authenticate, challenge}, _from, state) do
    case verify_challenge(challenge, state) do
      {:ok, token, new_state} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, token}, new_state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:register_callback, event_type, callback}, _from, state) do
    new_callbacks = Map.put(state.callbacks, event_type, callback)
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | callbacks: new_callbacks}}
  end

  def handle_call({:process_event, event}, _from, state) do
    case state.state do
      :authenticated ->
        result = dispatch_event(event, state)
        {:reply, result, state}
      _ ->
        {:reply, {:error, :not_authenticated}, state}
    end
  end

  defp verify_challenge(%{nonce: nonce, signature: sig, timestamp: ts} = challenge, state) do
    with :ok <- verify_timestamp(ts),
         :ok <- verify_nonce_unused(nonce, state),
         :ok <- verify_signature(sig, nonce, state.service_id) do
      token = generate_token(state.service_id, nonce)
      new_state = %{state |
        token: token,
        state: :authenticated,
        nonce_registry: MapSet.put(state.nonce_registry, nonce)
      }
      {:ok, token, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp verify_timestamp(ts) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if abs(now - ts) < 300, do: :ok, else: {:error, :expired}
  end

  defp verify_nonce_unused(nonce, state) do
    if MapSet.member?(state.nonce_registry, nonce),
      do: {:error, :nonce_reused},
      else: :ok
  end

  defp verify_signature(sig, nonce, service_id) do
    expected = :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{service_id}:#{nonce}:#{get_shared_secret()}")
    if sig == expected, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_signature}
  end

  defp generate_token(service_id, nonce) do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, "token:#{service_id}:#{nonce}:#{System.system_time(:nanosecond)}")
    |> Base.encode64()
  end

  defp get_shared_secret do
    Application.get_env(:monitor_agent, :shared_secret, "default-secret-change-me")
  end

  defp dispatch_event(%{type: event_type, payload: payload} = event, state) do
    case Map.get(state.callbacks, event_type) do
      nil ->
        Logger.info("No handler for event type: #{event_type}")
        {:ok, :no_handler}
      callback when is_function(callback, 1) ->
        execute_callback(callback, event, state)
    end
  end

  defp execute_callback(callback, event, state) do
    # Execute the callback which may trigger nested event processing
    # The callback receives the event and can call back into the agent
    result = callback.(event)
    # After callback execution, re-verify auth state
    # Note: state is captured at call entry - callback may have mutated GenServer state
    case result do
      {:emit, new_event} ->
        # Re-entrant dispatch: uses the state snapshot from the outer call
        dispatch_event(new_event, state)
      other ->
        {:ok, other}
    end
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.Logger do
  @moduledoc "Logging module that processes monitoring events"

  require Logger

  def setup_handlers do
    MonitorAgent.Auth.register_log_callback(:metric, &handle_metric/1)
    MonitorAgent.Auth.register_log_callback(:alert, &handle_alert/1)
    MonitorAgent.Auth.register_log_callback(:audit, &handle_audit/1)
  end

  defp handle_metric(%{payload: %{name: name, value: value}}) do
    Logger.info("Metric: #{name} = #{value}")
    {:ok, :logged}
  end

  defp handle_alert(%{payload: %{severity: sev, message: msg}} = event) do
    Logger.warn("Alert [#{sev}]: #{msg}")
    # Alerts with critical severity trigger an audit event
    if sev == :critical do
      {:emit, %{type: :audit, payload: %{action: :critical_alert, original: event}}}
    else
      {:ok, :alerted}
    end
  end

  defp handle_audit(%{payload: %{action: action} = payload}) do
    # Audit handler can process events that were emitted during auth transitions
    # This executes with the auth state snapshot from the ORIGINAL call
    log_entry = %{
      timestamp: System.system_time(:second),
      action: action,
      payload: payload
    }
    persist_audit_log(log_entry)
    {:ok, :audited}
  end

  defp persist_audit_log(entry) do
    # In production, this would write to a secure audit store
    File.write!("/var/log/monitor_agent/audit.log",
      :erlang.term_to_binary(entry),
      [:append])
  end
end
